charts.title: Online Agents
charts.description: The numeric value indicates the total number of agents who are currently available online at the moment.

charts.title: Agent Status
charts.description: The table displays the current status of agents, indicating whether they are currently available online or unavailable.

charts.title: Total Messages between Agents and Users
charts.description: The numeric value represents the total messages exchanged between the agent and the users.

charts.title: Top 5 Recent Messages
charts.description: This table displays the top five most frequently sent messages from users to the bot, ranked by their frequency of usage.

charts.title: Chats Currently in Queue
charts.description: The numeric value represents the number of customers awaiting for an agent

charts.title: Chats Currently in Queue Details
charts.description: The table shows the details of the customers that are waiting for an agent

charts.title: Online Customers (BOT)
charts.description: The numeric value shows the number of users that are actively chatting with the bot.

charts.title: Online Customers (Agents)
charts.description: The numeric value shows the number of users that are actively chatting with the agent.

charts.title: Interactions Arrived
charts.description: The table shows the number of handoff notifications that have been received by each agent in a given time period.

charts.title: Interactions Accepted
charts.description: The table shows the number of handoff requests that each agent accepted in a given time period.

charts.title: Handoff Called
charts.description: The numerical value indicates the count of customers who requested to chat with an agent in last 3 minutes

charts.title: Handoff Duration
charts.description: The table represents total handoff duration for each agent.

charts.title: Abandoned Chat Details
charts.description: The table displays the instances where chat sessions between agents and customers are ended prematurely, before being completed or initiated.

charts.title: Conversations
charts.description: The table presents a comprehensive view of the messages sent by the user to the bot.

charts.title: Agent Last Activity Time
charts.description: The table displays the latest timestamp at which an agent was active.

charts.title: Ended Chats
charts.description: The pie chart represents the chats that were ended either by user or the agents.

charts.title: Ongoing and Maximum Chat Details
charts.description: The table indicates the number of ongoing chats being handled by an agent and their maximum capacity to handle simultaneous chats.

charts.title: Agent Skill
charts.description: The table displays the details of the specific expertise of the agents knowledge to handle the queries of users.

charts.title: Currently Logged in Skills
charts.description: The table chart represents the currently active agents expertise, to handle the queries of users.
